propositions: rebar metrics subcommand must parse --since/--until date-range and --output format flag (json or text)
the metrics command renders every MetricSpec in the registry over the entire [since, until] range with no per-bucket bucketing
metrics.py must import rebar.metrics package (not just registry) to trigger reader module registration side-effects that hydrate REGISTRY
the render loop evaluates each MetricSpec and wraps calls in try/except to render exceptions as unavailable rather than crashing the command
JSON output includes every registered metric id with either a value object (lens, source, confidence) or unavailable object (reason, accruing_since); text output is one line per metric

the command is wired by an explicit if sub == "metrics" arm in _dispatch() on the reads path after store initialization, and must be added to the individual frozenset in test_help_overview_coverage.py
